title: Research 5 VP of AI Job Openings in Singapore
description: I need an agent to research and compile 5 recent VP of AI job openings in Singapore. For each job posting, you must find exactly 2 relevant LinkedIn contacts (e.g., hiring managers, recruiters, department heads) that I can send direct messages to in order to follow up on the job application. Deliver the results in a structured format with: 1) Job title, company, location, link to posting for each of the 5 jobs, 2) For each job: 2 LinkedIn profiles with name, title, profile URL, and brief note on why they're relevant.
